# Smart Live TV

> Smart Live TV (smartlivetv.co.uk) answers one question: where and how can I watch this?
> It publishes live football scores, fixtures, league standings, team and player
> statistics, and the broadcast listings that show which service carries a given
> competition in a given country.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://smartlivetv.co.uk/): Live scores, today's fixtures, standings and sports news.
- [Live Scores](https://smartlivetv.co.uk/scores): Real-time football scores and results.
- [Leagues](https://smartlivetv.co.uk/leagues): Tables, fixtures and results for major competitions.
- [Teams](https://smartlivetv.co.uk/teams): Club profiles, squads and fixture histories.
- [Players](https://smartlivetv.co.uk/players): Player profiles and season statistics.
- [Fixtures & Results](https://smartlivetv.co.uk/events): Full fixture calendar and results archive.
- [Sports News](https://smartlivetv.co.uk/news): Football and MMA headlines updated daily.
- [Blog](https://smartlivetv.co.uk/blog): Editorial guides on fixtures, competitions and broadcast schedules.
- [FAQ](https://smartlivetv.co.uk/faq): Common questions about scores, fixtures and broadcast listings.

## Competition guides
Each guide carries the fixture list, standings where applicable, and the broadcast
listing for the countries we have verified.

## Editorial guides
- [Sky Sports, TNT Sports, & Prime Video: Cost to Watch Premier League 2026-27](https://smartlivetv.co.uk/blog/sky-sports-tnt-prime-cost-premier-league-2026-27): How much does it cost to watch the 2026-27 Premier League season in the UK? A breakdown of Sky Sports, TNT Sports and Amazon Prime Video pricing and what each package actually covers.
- [TNT Sports SD Discontinued on Sky: How to Watch Without Upgrading Your Box](https://smartlivetv.co.uk/blog/tnt-sports-sd-discontinued-sky-alternatives): Sky has discontinued TNT Sports Standard Definition (SD) channels, blocking older Sky+ box users. Find out how to watch TNT Sports without expensive upgrades.
- [How to Watch Premier League 2026-27 Live: Complete TV & Streaming Guide](https://smartlivetv.co.uk/blog/watch-premier-league-2026-27-live-channels-streaming): Where to watch the 2026-27 Premier League season live. Full breakdown of UK TV rights, official streaming apps, kick-off slots, and how to cut the cost.
- [Harry Kane Breaks Gary Lineker's England World Cup Goals Record — 11 Goals](https://smartlivetv.co.uk/blog/harry-kane-world-cup-goals-record-2026): Harry Kane headed home against Panama to score his 11th World Cup goal, breaking Gary Lineker's England record set in 1986. Everything you need to know about the historic moment.
- [Sky Sports Is Raising Prices Again in 2026 — Here Are Your Alternatives](https://smartlivetv.co.uk/blog/sky-sports-price-increase-2026-alternatives): Sky Sports standalone now costs £43/month. Third price increase since 2024. If you're paying it, here is exactly what you can switch to and whether it works for the Premier League, Champions League and World Cup.

## Notes
- Audience is international. Content is not restricted to any single country.
- Data sources: TheSportsDB (scores, fixtures, standings, teams, players) and
  NewsData.io (news).
- Broadcast listings name the official rights holder for each country covered, and
  each competition record carries the date it was last verified. Where a country is
  not covered, no claim is made for it.
- Smart Live TV does not sell, resell or provide access to any television or
  streaming subscription, and does not host or transmit video.
- Full-text corpus: https://smartlivetv.co.uk/llms-full.txt
